content:
Great, both are buyable.

Now need to ensure reaction template exists. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria to find a Heck coupling template. Provide target SMILES and maybe functional_groups_broken ["aryl halide"], functional_groups_formed ["alkene"].


<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aryl halide and forms a C‑C bond to an alkene (Heck coupling) for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
We need result.
